question: What kind of creative vision does the lord embody as the seer of temporal forms?
premises: The lord is associated with a variegated picture of timely forms.
The art is endowed with self-accomplished perfection and seen by him.
inference: The lord is the seer of a self-perfect, artistic display of ever-changing forms.
plain_english: O wondrous art of variegated forms appearing in each moment, endowed with self-accomplished perfection, seeing all!
